## The question

[Figure in the table with Tikz](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/11994/figure-in-the-table-with-tikz), asked by [Regis Santos](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1940/regis-santos) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-02-25; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> How do I align a figure Tikz item at the top of the table? Its my result.
>
> ![my result][q-1]
>
>
> ![enter image description here][q-2]
>
>
>   [q-1]: 8U4dS.jpg
>   [q-2]: BgIbP.jpg
>
> I need the second alignment.
:::

Use the `baseline` key:

```latex
\begin{tikzpicture}[baseline=(current bounding box.north)]
```
